spec.name: TimeMonitor
spec.description: Windows clock offset, delay and w32time status written by TimeMonitor.py (bucket ClockMetrics).

charts.name: Consensus offset
charts.note: Median of the latest offset from each server sampled in the last 10 minutes (older samples are left out because the PC clock drifts).

queries.query:
from(bucket: "ClockMetrics")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Offset_s")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> median()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1000.0}))

charts.name: Server spread
charts.note: Largest minus smallest latest offset among servers sampled in the last 10 minutes. A large spread points to a bad server or network path.

queries.query:
from(bucket: "ClockMetrics")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Offset_s")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> spread()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1000.0}))

charts.name: Stratum
charts.note: Windows Time stratum. 1 with source Local CMOS Clock means it is not syncing.

queries.query:
from(bucket: "ClockMetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Stratum")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()

charts.name: w32time poll interval
charts.note: How often Windows Time polls its source.

queries.query:
from(bucket: "ClockMetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "PollSeconds")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()

charts.name: Offset by server (raw)
charts.note: Every sample. Spikes usually match spikes in round-trip delay.

queries.query:
from(bucket: "ClockMetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Offset_s")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1000.0}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "ReferenceNTPServer"])

charts.name: Offset, lowest-delay sample per minute
charts.note: For each server, only the sample with the smallest round-trip delay in each minute. Removes most delay spikes.

queries.query:
from(bucket: "ClockMetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Offset_s" or r._field == "Delay_s")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "ReferenceNTPServer"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> window(every: 1m)
  |> min(column: "Delay_s")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _measurement: r._measurement, ReferenceNTPServer: r.ReferenceNTPServer, _field: "offset", _value: r.Offset_s * 1000.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "ReferenceNTPServer"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "ReferenceNTPServer"])

charts.name: Public servers (last value held)
charts.note: Servers with public addresses. They are sampled rarely, so each value is held until the next sample.

queries.query:
from(bucket: "ClockMetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Offset_s")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ReferenceNTPServer !~ /^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.)/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1000.0}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "ReferenceNTPServer"])

charts.name: Offset +/- delay/2, local servers
charts.note: For servers with private (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x) addresses: the true offset lies between low and high.

queries.query:
data = from(bucket: "ClockMetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Offset_s" or r._field == "Delay_s")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ReferenceNTPServer =~ /^(10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.)/)
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "ReferenceNTPServer"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

low = data |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _measurement: r._measurement, ReferenceNTPServer: r.ReferenceNTPServer, _field: "low", _value: (r.Offset_s - r.Delay_s / 2.0) * 1000.0}))
mid = data |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _measurement: r._measurement, ReferenceNTPServer: r.ReferenceNTPServer, _field: "offset", _value: r.Offset_s * 1000.0}))
high = data |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _measurement: r._measurement, ReferenceNTPServer: r.ReferenceNTPServer, _field: "high", _value: (r.Offset_s + r.Delay_s / 2.0) * 1000.0}))

union(tables: [low, mid, high])
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "ReferenceNTPServer", "_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "ReferenceNTPServer", "_field"])

from(bucket: "ClockMetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Delay_s")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1000.0}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "ReferenceNTPServer"])

charts.name: w32time status
charts.note: No data in this time range.

queries.query:
import "strings"

from(bucket: "ClockMetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Stratum" or r._field == "Source" or r._field == "ReferenceIP" or r._field == "LastSync" or r._field == "PollSeconds")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: string(v: r._value)}))
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with host: r._measurement, LastSync: strings.replaceAll(v: r.LastSync, t: "_", u: " ")}))
  |> keep(columns: ["host", "Stratum", "Source", "ReferenceIP", "PollSeconds", "LastSync"])

charts.name: Latest sample per server
charts.note: No row for a server: no sample in this time range.

queries.query:
n = int(v: now())

from(bucket: "ClockMetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Offset_s" or r._field == "Delay_s")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "ReferenceNTPServer"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      host: r._measurement,
      server: r.ReferenceNTPServer,
      offset_ms: r.Offset_s * 1000.0,
      delay_ms: r.Delay_s * 1000.0,
      age_s: (n - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000,
      last_sample: r._time}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["host", "server"])

from(bucket: "ClockMetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Stratum")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "ClockMetrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "PollSeconds")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
